summary:
Main
The DCE iron ore futures trended weaker, with the most-traded contract I2609 finally closing at766 yuan/mt, down 0.91% from the previous trading session. Port spot prices fell 1-5 yuan/mt from the previous day. Traders' quotng interest was not high; steel mills mainly restocked as needed, with few inquiries; as of now, spot transactions were limited.
